title: PAN
text:
[ 5. Residence Address ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#05)
It is a mandatory field. [ 6. Office Address](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#06)
  * (i) It is an optional field except in case of Sole proprietor. * (ii) If office address is selected as address for communication, then proof of office address is mandatory. [ 7. Residence Status ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#07)
It is mandatory to select one of the options as applicable. [ 8. Passport Number ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#08)
If applicant is Non-resident/Resident but not ordinarily resident, Passport Number is mandatory. [ 9. Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) in the Country of Residence (if any). ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#09)
It is an optional field. [ 10. Contact Details ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#10)
  1. It is mandatory for the applicants to mention their "Mobile Number" and "e-mail id". 2. Mobile Number should include Country Code and Landline Number (if any) should include STD Code. (i) Mobile Number **9102511111** of India should be written as:
Country Code  
|   | 9  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- |  
Mobile Number  
| 9  | 1  | 0  | 2  | 5  | 1  | 1  | 1  | 1  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Where '91' is the Country Code of India. (ii) Email ID: -
(iii) Landline Number **23555705** of Delhi should be written as: 
STD Code  
|   |   |   | 1  | 1  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Landline Number  
| 2  | 3  | 5  | 5  | 5  | 7  | 0  | 5  |  
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |  
Where '11' is the STD Code of Delhi. [ 11. Source of Income ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#11)
It is mandatory to select at least one of the options, as mentioned in the form. In case of multiple sources of income, more than one option can be selected. [ 12. Whether mother/father is a single parent? (select one)](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#12)
It is mandatory to fill in both parents’ details, except in single parent cases. In case of death of either of the parents’/divorce/separation, the applicant should not select single parent as ‘yes’ and give details of both the parents for the purpose of this application. However, applicants can select one of the parents for name to be printed on the PAN card as mentioned at S. [ 13. Father’ Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#13)
To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name. Married woman applicant shall give her father’s name and not husband’s name. [ 14. Mother’s Name ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/instructions-form_93-form_94.html#14)
To be filled as First Name/ Middle Name/Last Name.
